lines.text: Sri Ch. Naveen Kumar, Senior Assistant, Regional Office, Eluru has requested a transfer to Regional Office, Vijayawada on spouse grounds.
In File USD01-12/31/2022-ESTT.I, Note #5, on 20-06-2022, the transfer was approved and orders were issued.
In File USD01-12/77/2023-ESTT.I, Note #5, on 02-09-2023, the transfer was not agreed at present, as the ban on transfers was in force.
In File USD01-12/44/2025-ESTT.I, Note #5, on 27-05-2025, the transfer was approved.
In File USD01-12/58/2025-ESTT.I, Note #4, on 30-05-2025, the transfer was not considered in view of the pending enquiry.
Under AP-FIN01-GOMS-31-2025, the ban on transfers is relaxed for the period from 15-05-2025 to 31-05-2025.
Transfers in any category shall not exceed 15% of the cadre strength of that category, and no relaxation of this ceiling shall be made without the prior concurrence of the Finance Department.
Spouse cases, where both spouses are State Government employees, shall be given preference subject to availability of vacancy.
The competent authority for transfers of Section Officers and below in the Secretariat Departments shall be the Secretary to Government of the Department concerned.
After 31-05-2025, the ban on transfers shall come into force again, and no transfer shall thereafter be ordered without the prior approval of the Government in the Finance Department.
Prior clearance of the Vigilance section is required for transfers of employees facing vigilance enquiries or disciplinary proceedings under AP-GAD01-CIRMEMO-GAD01SERA0-3-2023-D20230814.
Sri Ch. Naveen Kumar has requested a transfer on spouse grounds, which are given preference subject to availability of vacancy.

Review recommended to verify applicability before approval, as there is a potential conflict regarding reliance on AP-FIN01-GOMS-88-2022 (03-06-2022) which appears superseded by AP-FIN01-GOMS-31-2025 (12-05-2025).
Review recommended to verify the authority, as there is a potential conflict regarding reliance on AP-FIN01-GOMS-104-2026 which was not found among indexed records.
Review recommended to confirm if the transfer can be made at this time, as the proposal is dated 22-09-2026, which is outside the period 15-05-2025 to 31-05-2025.
Review recommended to submit to Secretary to Government, as the proposal seeks approval by Deputy Secretary, who can only recommend, while the competent authority is Secretary to Government.
It is submitted that the request of Sri Ch. Naveen Kumar, Senior Assistant, Regional Office, Eluru for transfer to Regional Office, Vijayawada on spouse grounds may kindly be considered.
